reviews.name: Leon Mat
reviews.text:
I had an absolutely amazing experience on my safari tour! My guide was incredibly friendly and made the whole trip unforgettable. He took his time to show me everything in great detail — from majestic elephants to crocodiles and so many other fascinating animals. His knowledge and patience really stood out, and I could tell he genuinely cared about making sure I enjoyed every moment.
He was helpful throughout the entire journey and made sure I felt comfortable and safe. I truly appreciate the care and attention he gave to every part of the tour. I highly recommend this safari operator to anyone looking for a top-notch, memorable wildlife experience!

reviews.name: Karim Benslimane
reviews.text:
Me and my girlfriend has an amazing safari experience during the early morning. Nuwan and driver Jonathan have given us a day we shall not forget soon.
Thanks to Jonathan's great driving skills we were able to see many animals up close — elephants, crocodiles, water buffalo, peacocks, and so many birds. Nuwan really knows the park and made the whole experience feel special.

reviews.name: Gerd-Hendric Suhle
reviews.text: Our safari was an absolute highlight! The driver was not only highly skilled but also had an impressive knowledge of the local wildlife and flora. What stood out the most was his keen eye for detail: he didn't just point out the big animals but also the smaller, often-overlooked creatures and plants that make the ecosystem so special. A truly enriching experience — highly recommended!

reviews.name: Jack Ryan
reviews.text: This was mine and my partners first safari and it did not disappoint. Our tour guide Nuwan's knowledge and keen eye for both flora and fauna made this safari extra special. He was also super friendly with great English making it very easy to communicate and ask questions. Would highly recommend Udawalawe Wild for anyone visiting the area!

reviews.name: Julien Rondeaux
reviews.text: We are very happy with our safari tour! We did it in the afternoon and we saw so many elephants (and baby elephants) from super close! But also peacocks, buffalos, monkeys, a crocodile and lots of birds. Nuwan was our driver and guide at the same time and he was excellent — very knowledgeable, friendly, and patient. The whole experience felt respectful and well-organised.
